threads.body: `_seen_span_operations()` currently increments once per *attribute occurrence*. If a sampled span ever carries duplicate `gen_ai.operation.name` attributes (e.g., from an SDK bug or test fixture), this will over-count operations and make `Scenario.validate()` fail even though the span count is correct. Counting at most once per span sample makes the helper more robust while preserving current behavior for well-formed spans.
